claims.note: The wall starts again for any grounded runner past x0 at the foot's height; no shipped course has that ground, so it is latent.
The mantle target uses the wall height, not the radius; no course sets a radius and where the deck stands is the course author's call.
After a failed wall the height was read 1 m from the foot, the runner stood 0.5 m from it; wrong by the step between them.
A stumble that comes due during wall, hang, swing, vault or climb is not sounded or counted on its tick; it waits until the runner is back in run mode.
A jump pressed on the very tick of trampoline touchdown is lost (the early check reads the previous lastPress).
Equal-height platforms tie to the first in the list; the list is course data, so a course always plays the same.
Zero grip while standing still made x NaN (0 / 0). No shipped setting uses zero grip.
Kept on purpose: src/modes/course.ts sounds an events array once, so the old array must stay.
Hands exactly on the rope anchor give an infinite swing speed; needs an exact point, so it is theory only.
Letting go in the first 8 ticks after a bar grab starts the flight without the hand offset the screen showed (up to 0.6 m x 0.48 m jump).
bounce() would give a late press a pump, but the world records a press only while the feet are on the bed.
The comment states the rule: only the upward speed is limited; hands may close while falling.
On a top narrower than 0.15 m the vault lands 5 cm past its far edge.
playImperfect keeps only three plan fields, so with zero noise it cannot clear the Training course (returns null). Used by two tests on the stock course only.
The restart second is added to the attempt that clears, so every time is 1 s long. Test-only function.
The comment says the longest run of consecutive good presses; the code takes the lowest to the highest good press, so a window with a hole is reported too wide.
The bounce press is tuned only for take-off edges between 117 m and 119 m; the Training course trampoline (133 m) keeps the default 8, and a press of 0 clears 5 ticks (0.04 s) faster.
181 ticks standing still, not 180: a one-tick slip with no effect.
'not-grounded' is a dead member of the result type; an airborne runner is predicted on purpose.
